camila: Heads up — GitOps rollout to us-west-2 failed CI on the gpu-pool helm chart. It worked locally but the pipeline lint/templates step blew up during rendering. Anyone seen this pattern?

ci-bot: [pipeline] helm template ./charts/gpu-pool --values ./overlays/us-west/values.yaml exited 1
```
Error: template: gpu-pool/templates/deployment.yaml:47:22: executing "gpu-pool/templates/deployment.yaml" at <index .Values.nodeSelector "nvidia.com/gpu">: error calling index: index of nil map
```

ryan: This is the classic nil map -> index crash. In our overlays some environments omit `nodeSelector` entirely, and the template does `{{ .Values.nodeSelector.nvidia.com/gpu }}` so helm tries to index a nil map.

aj: Yep. Two common fixes: 1) guard with `with` or `default` to an empty dict, or 2) use `index` safely after defaulting. E.g.:
```
{{- $ns := .Values.nodeSelector | default dict }}
nodeSelector: {{- if $ns }}
  {{ toYaml $ns | nindent 2 }}
{{- else }}{}
{{- end }}
```
This avoids index-of-nil. Also avoid dot-key names with dots — use `index` with string key if you need dotted keys.

sophia: helm lint didn't catch because our chart-testing runs with a values.yaml that includes nodeSelector. The GitOps overlay for several regions intentionally omits it to let cluster autoscaler pick nodes; pipeline uses `helm template` without supplying fallback values. We should add a lint matrix case with empty/absent maps.

camila: Agreed. For immediates, I'll open a small patch that defaults the map and uses `index` defensively. Will also add a unit (chart-testing/helm unittest) case for an empty values file.

ryan: Another gotcha: we have a helper `helpers.tpl` that merges node labels: `{{- $merged := merge .Values.nodeSelector .Values.extraNodeSelector }}` — merge fails if either is nil. Use `default dict` for both operands.

aj: We should also add a lint job in our GitOps pipeline that runs `helm template` with `--values /dev/null` or a deliberately minimal values set to catch this class of issues. Could add a `ci/helm-minimal-values.yaml` that only contains required fields.

ci-bot: [pipeline] Created issue: infra/helm: gpu-pool template crash on missing nodeSelector (link: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/issues/412)

camila: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/989 — patch uses `| default dict` in helpers and adds a chart-test case. Will add a follow-up to update our chart-testing matrix in the GitOps CI.

sophia: Also flagging cost/regional impact: if nodeSelector keys differ by region we should normalize keys in values schema or document per-region overlays. The last time a bad nodeSelector slipped through we scheduled expensive dedicated GPUs in eu-west because the label didn't match. :facepalm:

ryan: Good call. We can add schema `anyOf` for labels shape, but be careful — `anyOf` sometimes makes lint rules noisy. Better approach: explicit `nodeSelector` schema with `additionalProperties: true` but `type: object` so empty map is allowed.

aj: TL;DR: short-term fix in PR to default nil maps, add minimal-values lint case to GitOps CI, medium-term: update values.schema.json and chart-testing matrix, long-term: add automated smoke deploy to a small gpu pool in staging before regional rollouts.

camila: Sounds good. Will merge the patch after CI passes and kick the rollout again. Thanks all.

sophia: Thanks — can someone add a quick note in the rollout checklist about verifying `values.schema.json` for map fields? Saved us a production scare before.

ryan: done — added a checklist item in the rollout doc (link: https://docs.internal/redwood/rollouts#helm-values-check)

camila: CI is green on the PR, merging now. If the GitOps redeploy still fails I'll roll back and open an incident.

ci-bot: [pipeline] Redeploy triggered for cluster us-west-2 by camila (deploy/infra-gpu-pool v2.1.3)

camila: deploying...

ci-bot: [deploy] gpu-pool rollout succeeded in us-west-2 :tada:

camila: closing this thread — thanks everyone for quick help!
